_doc: The slice's growth rules (design/slice/systems.md §2). Every number is a placeholder: tune here, not in code. Wells and the Ring reset each loop; Practice (spell levels) resets too, but grows 'echo_mult' times faster below the best a Model reached in an earlier loop, and faster again with insight (data/world/lives.json, +1 a life). Wells grow 'echo_mult' times faster below the most you held in an earlier loop.
_ring_doc: The 1st Ring is the yard trial (the story sets the flag 'ring1'); each later Ring needs that many wells.
_ring_stages_doc: Spells at stage each Ring also needs (spell spec §6.6): [how many, stage], stage 1 Adept, 2 Master. The 1st Ring is still the yard trial alone.
_grade_doc: The Force grade cap each Ring allows (spell spec §6.6): Apprentice I, 1st and 2nd II, 3rd and 4th III.
_cap_doc: The 4th Ring is as far as the slice goes: wells stop growing at well_cap.
